 After Como-Venezia, it's time for Frosinone-Torino and Lazio-Cagliari to take to the pitch. Let's look at the managers' confirmed line-ups.
 ✅ FROSINONE-TORINO
 Frosinone 1 Torino 0 69' FROSINONE (4-2-3-1) : Palmisani; Tchato, Calvani, Monterisi, Bracaglia; Masini, Calò; Ghedjemis, Schmid, Kvernadze; Raimondo.
 TORINO (3-5-2) : Perri; Coco, Ismajli, Comuzzo; Belghali, Vlasic, Braganca, Gineitis, Aboukhlal; Adams, Simeone.
 ✅ LAZIO-CAGLIARI
 Lazio 1 Cagliari 1 71' LAZIO (4-3-3) : Mandas; Floriani, Sutalo, Provstgaard, Nuno Tavares; Frattesi, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Noslin, Zaccagni.
 CAGLIARI (4-3-2-1) : Caprile; Zé Pedro, Deiola, Rodriguez, Obert; Adopo, Romano, Fazzini; Fadera, Maldini; N'Zola.
